  • 英語名: Cafe Aqua

别名

  • Café AQUA

あらすじ

Never before could I have imagined myself becoming the victim of a traffic accident. I’m fine, but my wallet’s on the verge of death. My bike’s repair fees come out to a hundred and fifty thousand yen. To pay them off, I started working at Cafe Aqua.

It’s just a few minutes away from the nearby train station. Its menu features aromatic tea and delicious pastries, as well as other foods. Some of my classmates also work here, serving customers with smiles on their faces while wearing cute uniforms.

  • 英語名: Kizumono no Shoujo -Kizumono no Gakuen Gaiden-

あらすじ

The “Kazaoto Academy Student Guerrilla Incident”. An incident where roughly all survivors suffered greatly. The women, raped. The men who refused to rape, killed. And now, once again, a new humiliation play was about to begin…

After the terrifying incident took place, part of the students who attended Kazaoto Academy transfered schools. And so, the stage changes to the preparatory school, Mizuto Academy, which two of the incident’s victims attended. They were Oomura Takeshi and Shindou Narumi.

item.title: C' ~Can't Live Without You~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Rasen
  • 発売日: 2001-02-23
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: C’～can’t live without you～
  • 英語名: C’ Can’t Live Without You

あらすじ

This game is about our hero, Kyou Kisaragi and his girlfriend, Wakana Mizuhashi. These lovers live together while attending consecutive years at college. This story is a novel about their lives vividly described with multi-scenarios. It is centered on their hot life living together, with busy costume playing at night. Each day, these young bodies seek each other out. Their relationship changes as you decide whether they make love or not. You’ll enjoy their continuous day-to-day intensive play. Since they are college students, they do go to school in the daytime. Our hero has other girls that he meets up with; it’s up to you to decide how far to go with them…
